stage0093a_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$號$$
「The space between time and space...
　A different dimension that belongs to no world...」

stage0093a_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$凱$$
「Were we sent flying from Paradigm City
　by $$ハーデス$$!?」

stage0093a_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ミーナ#182$$
「Every instrument and system
　has lost track of our current position!」

stage0093a_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$キャシー$$
「We've confirmed recovery of every $c member!
　$$ロジャー・スミス$$ is among them!」

stage0093a_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$モニカ$$
「We've confirmed Mycenaean forces besides the black Aquarion!
　There's quite a number of them!」

stage0093a_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Does $$ハーデス$$ mean to crush us right here!?」

stage0093a_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「No... we're probably nothing more than foreign objects caught up in this.」

stage0093a_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Well met, survivor of the Wings!
　No, $$堕天翅$$ would suit you better!」

stage0093a_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「How pitiful, so-called $$ミカゲ$$!
　Fallen 120 million years ago, lost 24,000
　years ago, and deceived 12,000 years ago!」

stage0093a_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I won't let a weakling like you have your way with Earth!
　That world belongs to us, the gods of Olympus!」

stage0093a_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A vile god who seeks nothing but power...!
　I won't let the likes of you stand in the way of my resolve!」

stage0093a_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So, you resist after all.」

stage0093a_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Resist?
　This is why those who don't know their words are such trouble.」

stage0093a_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What comes now is divine punishment.
　Yes... I myself shall pass judgment upon you.」

stage0093a_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Interesting! Truly interesting, $$堕天翅$$!
　You'd start a war of gods right here!?」

stage0093a_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「A god-on-god battle, first in ages...!
　These arms of the Brave are itching for it!」

stage0093a_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Lord $$ハーデス$$!
　Leave the disposal of that $$堕天翅$$ to me!」

stage0093a_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「No, I myself shall tear off its wings,
　and offer its blood to Lord $$ハーデス$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Now that the embodiment of cosmic darkness has fallen,
　defeating even it will make Earth belong to us,
　the gods of Olympus!」

stage0093a_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Don't just go deciding things on your own!!」

stage0093a_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$甲児$$
「As long as we're here,
　we won't let you do as you please with Earth!」

stage0093a_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Now that I think of it, you lot were here too.」

stage0093a_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「To be caught up in a battle against the $$堕天翅$$...
　how unlucky for you.」

stage0093a_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Sit quietly and tremble in a corner.
　Once we've dealt with the $$堕天翅$$, we'll take you on after.」

stage0093a_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Being here together must be fate!
　We'll smash Mycenae and $$ミカゲ$$ both, all at once!」

stage0093a_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You still don't understand your place, wingless one?」

stage0093a_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The likes of you, who wandered onto a battlefield of gods, are as good as trash!
　You're not even worth our notice!」

stage0093a_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$刹那$$
「Are you saying we, humanity, are as good as trash!?」

stage0093a_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Indeed, among Earthlings, you're the better sort.」

stage0093a_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「And it's true, too, that you live in the age of the sun.」

stage0093a_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But it's not enough.
　You'll need another thousand years or more
　to stand shoulder to shoulder with us.」

stage0093a_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We'll leap right over something like that!
　With the strength of all of us together!」

stage0093a_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You still don't understand the situation?」

stage0093a_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アルト$$
「A punch came out of nowhere!」

stage0093a_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Is he using
　the Mugen Attack too!?」

stage0093a_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「'He'...?
　Heh heh, seems the wingless
　don't even know the right words.」

stage0093a_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アンディ$$
「But that just now was weird!」

stage0093a_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Th-that Aquarion's Mugen Attack...!
　The punch came flying first,
　and then an arm grew out of it!」

stage0093a_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Cause and effect, reversed...!
　His punch transcends causality!」

stage0093a_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How laughable, for a mere
　wing dog to speak of infinity.」

stage0093a_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The power of a god is truly infinite...
　It appears in any place.
　It grants its blessing at any time.」

stage0093a_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「E-even for the Aquarion,
　that's completely crazy!!」

stage0093a_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So this is the power of
　the Wings of the sun, ridden
　by the $$堕天翅$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$シモン$$
「If we're not careful,
　it might be stronger now
　than when Apollo rode it!」

stage0093a_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$バサラ$$
「That guy...!
　He's twisting $$シェリル$$ and
　$$ランカ$$'s song!」

stage0093a_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$シェリル$$
「You!
　What did you do to our song!?」

stage0093a_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$!
　Are you two riding
　the black Aquarion too!?」

stage0093a_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Love and hatred are two sides
　of the same coin... The slightest
　misunderstanding turns love to hatred.」

stage0093a_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The Wings of the sun now carries
　two songstresses and two maidens,
　forming a great triangle with the boys they love.」

stage0093a_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So that's the source of his power!」

stage0093a_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The two great triangles of love
　were converted by my power into
　triangles of hatred. That's my power's source...」

stage0093a_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$木下$$
「N-no way...!
　Lady $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$-chan's love...!」

stage0093a_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カレン$$
「Twisting a woman's feelings
　to suit yourself!
　I'll never forgive that!」

stage0093a_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Forgive? That's a word only
　gods get to use, wingless one.」

stage0093a_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「He's completely ruled by hatred!」

stage0093a_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You mean to destroy the world with that power as it stands...!」

stage0093a_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:

$$ゼウス$$

　space and time. Guided by it,
　I descended to this place」

stage0093a_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Nnngh!
　To think you'd materialize again!」

stage0093a_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Hear me, $$ハーデス$$!
　And you too, sorrowful $$堕天翅$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「A god's duty is not to wield his power
　as his desires or emotions dictate!」

stage0093a_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「It is to become a model for all who live in this universe,
　and to guide those who follow!」

stage0093a_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Spare me the pretty words, $$ゼウス$$!
　What we desire is to defeat them, and become
　overlord of every universe in existence!」

stage0093a_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「To defeat them, and settle all this accumulated hatred!」

stage0093a_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「If words won't reach you, then there's no talking!
　I'll join hands with the humans who carry the light,
　and send you evil gods back to the underworld!」

stage0093a_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Are you ready for battle, warriors...
　no, heroes of steel!!」

stage0093a_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$シモン$$
「We're all fired up and ready to go!」

stage0093a_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$甲児$$
「Let's do this, $$ゼウス$$!
　Our target is $$ハーデス$$ and the black Aquarion!」

stage0093a_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Damn you, $$ゼウス$$!
　Then I'll destroy you along with the humans and the $$堕天翅$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Come, then, wingless ones.
　Offer your lives, together with the
　gods of Olympus, to the new myth I shall forge.」

stage0093a_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$, $$ゼシカ$$!
　I'm coming!」

stage0093a_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$アルト$$
「Wait for us, $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$!
　We'll definitely save you!」

stage0093a_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$號$$
「Evolution built on power alone, forgetting
　the heart, has no future! Gods, you'd best learn that!」

stage0093a_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　We'll settle this with Mycenae and $$ミカゲ$$, here and now!!」

stage0093a_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$さやか$$
「We beat both $$ハーデス$$ and $$ミカゲ$$, but...」

stage0093a_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ボス$$
「But still...!
　How do we get back to our world from this other dimension?」

stage0093a_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$n
「We... did protect the world, didn't we...」

stage0093a_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$クロス$$
「We did all we could do.
　That's good enough, ain't it?」

stage0093a_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「That's about the size of it.
　Whatever happens next, happens.」

stage0093a_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$桂$$
「It's frustrating not to get to see
　how $$エタニティ・フラット$$'s ending plays out...」

stage0093a_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What is it, Captain $$アムロ$$?」

stage0093a_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$エタニティ・フラット$$ and Geminis...
　$$シャア$$ will find some way to handle them...
　Or is that just wishful thinking on my part...）

$$渓$$
「Isn't there anything we can do, $$號$$?」

stage0093a_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:

「...Where there is hope, light is born.」

stage0093a_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$號$$
「$$甲児$$, call out to $$ゼウス$$.」

stage0093a_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$號$$
「He hasn't been destroyed.
　Give shape to his will, once more.」

stage0093a_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$甲児$$
「But even if I try to call out,
　I don't even know where $$ゼウス$$ is...」

stage0093a_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$甲児$$, please come to the Quarter.」

stage0093a_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The Z-Chip has the power to amplify mental wavelengths.
　If we use that power, it might carry Master $$甲児$$'s
　voice across dimensions, to Master $$ゼウス$$.」

stage0093a_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've fitted Z-Chips around the Pilder.
　With this...」

stage0093a_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「GN Particles will carry $$甲児$$'s will even further.」

stage0093a_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$シェリル$$
「If we're to cross dimensions,
　surely our song can lend its strength too.」

stage0093a_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$宗介$$
「The rest is up to you.」

stage0093a_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$甲児$$
「Can you hear me, $$ゼウス$$?
　Lend us your strength, once more.」

stage0093a_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$甲児$$
「We still have things we have to do.
　That's why we have to go back.」

stage0093a_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$!
　Lend us the power of that light, once more!」

stage0093a_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「My friend, $$兜甲児$$.
　Your call crossed the dimensions and saved me,
　as I was falling into a world of darkness.」

stage0093a_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Unfortunately, I have almost no power
　left as a god now...」

stage0093a_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Even so, I should still be able to
　send you back to your own world.」

stage0093a_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Now, let us go home, heroes of steel.
　Your battle is not yet over.」

stage0093a_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Somewhat, yes.
　Thank you for saving him.」

stage0093a_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$不動$$
「He's a friend of your friend, after all.
　I could hardly ignore that.」

stage0093a_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Let's just leave it at that.」

stage0093a_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$カヲル$$
「I'm grateful that you acted, given how
　much you hate getting involved.」

stage0093a_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Thank you, $$不動$$.
　I'm glad I got to meet you.」

stage0093a_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$不動$$

　create the myth. Let's look forward to it too.」

stage0093a_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:

「So, you've defeated $$ガラダブラ$$, bearer of

「Playing the big shot ends right here!」

stage0093a_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ハーデス$$!
　I'll defeat you, here and now!」

stage0093a_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't you dare speak my name so casually, human!」

stage0093a_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The fight's not over yet!
　$$ミコノ$$, get back to the Quarter!」

stage0093a_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Got it, $$アマタ$$!
　...But I'm fighting too...!
　To protect the world together with you!」

stage0093a_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Got it, $$ミコノ$$!
　Let's do this together!」

stage0093a_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So, you've defeated the $$堕天翅$$...!
　Not bad, you humans!」

stage0093a_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$シモン$$
「Playing the big shot ends right here!」

stage0093a_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ハーデス$$!
　I'll defeat you, here and now!」

stage0093a_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't you dare speak my name so casually, human!」

stage0093a_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$シモン$$
「Playing the big shot ends right here!」

stage0093a_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ハーデス$$!
　I'll defeat you, here and now!」

stage0093a_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't you dare speak my name so casually, human!」

stage0093a_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Is $$ハーデス$$ causing this!?」

stage0093a_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That's right!
　My wrath shakes the very dimensions,
　and my roar rips through them!」

stage0093a_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You humans!
　You'll regret ever making me angry!」

stage0093a_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Acknowledge the power of humanity, $$ハーデス$$!
　That world belongs to those born upon it!」

stage0093a_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Let us return to the stars and prepare
　for the battle against $$バアル$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Silence, $$ゼウス$$!
　With that world's $$オリジン・ロー$$,
　we might just be able to defeat them!」

stage0093a_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$ハーデス$$! Have words lost
　all meaning to one possessed
　by power!」

stage0093a_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「It's too late for it all now!
　Humans, $$ゼウス$$, be swallowed by this
　alien dimension and wander it forever!」

stage0093a_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「It's useless, $$ゼウス$$!
　You know the fury of my wrath as well as anyone!」

stage0093a_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「But I cannot let the light of hope be
　snuffed out! I'll take on your flames of wrath myself!」

stage0093a_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Are you trying to get yourself killed!?
　Do that, and you'll lose your light and fall
　into the darkness at the edge of the dimensions!」

stage0093a_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Even if my own light is lost,
　there are those who will inherit its power and fight on!」

stage0093a_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「The rest is up to you, $$兜甲児$$!
　I entrust my power to you, and to the demon god!!」

stage0093a_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Fool!
　Once called one of the Three Great Gods
　of Olympus, and you throw your life away for mere humans!」

stage0093a_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$'s heart is still alive!
　That light is with us!」

stage0093a_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$甲児$$
「Power is welling up from Mazinger!
　Is this... what $$ゼウス$$ gave me!?」

stage0093a_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$號$$
「That's right!
　That's the power of will that transcends
　even dimensions...! The power of light!!」

stage0093a_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ボス$$
「Wh-whoa! That's even more
　power than before!!」

stage0093a_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$安$$
「Heh...!
　So it's the demon god of light who got power
　from the giant god of light!」

stage0093a_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「The enemy is the King of the Underworld!
　No opponent could ask for more!」

stage0093a_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Yeah...! We absolutely
　can't lose this fight!」

stage0093a_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do it, for the future!」

stage0093a_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Nuoooh!! You humans! You, $$ゼウス$$!!
　You've truly angered me now!!」

stage0093a_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Those are the Mechanical Beasts
　we've already beaten!?」

stage0093a_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$安$$
「They've come back from hell, huh!
　Gloomy bunch」

stage0093a_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Did you see that, you humans!
　This is my power!」

stage0093a_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「These ones died bearing hatred for you!
　I gave their remains new souls!」

stage0093a_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't get cocky, old man!
　Lining up junk heaps won't make
　us scared, no matter how many!」

stage0093a_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I've got zero interest in your cheap tricks!
　All we're here to do is crush you!」

stage0093a_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$赤木$$
「Like hell I'll let you do as you please
　with Earth! I'll take you down right here!」

stage0093a_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$タケル$$
「We're here with the resolve to die!
　To protect Earth's future!!」

stage0093a_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$n
「So a mere human's taunt gets your blood boiling!
　No matter your power, you're unworthy
　of the name of god!」

stage0093a_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$甲児$$
「Here we come, $$ハーデス$$!
　Our light will banish
　your darkness!!」

stage0093a_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「W-well done, you humans...!
　To defeat me, $$ガラダブラ$$, hailed as the brave!」

stage0093a_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I pass my name of the brave to you!」

stage0093a_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That was a hell of a finish, $$ガラダブラ$$」

stage0093a_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「The name of the brave you gave me...
　I shall accept it」

stage0093a_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$甲児$$
「Mycenae's brave one has fallen!
　Now all that's left is you, $$ハーデス$$!!」

stage0093a_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Damn you...! Damn youuuu!!
　How dare you...!」

stage0093a_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Humans, you will regret this!
　With your power, you cannot break
　the Prison of Time!」

stage0093a_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Even if you did break it,
　what awaits is $$バアル$$'s onslaught!
　And then, they'll come too!」

stage0093a_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That's not all! A fundamental
　calamity will strike you all,
　eventually!」

stage0093a_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「As I thought, you understand nothing!
　You'll never cross the 12,000-year
　wheel of rebirth like that!」

stage0093a_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Answer me, $$ハーデス$$!
　What is this 12,000-year wheel!?」

stage0093a_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That's the cycle of the universe's rebirth!
　Then $$バアル$$ swarms to erase the universe's
　life... its spirit particles!」

stage0093a_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Th-the thing being reborn
　isn't people...」

stage0093a_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$バアル$$'s... the space monsters'
　appearance, that's the reason!?」

stage0093a_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You will perish before you ever
　touch that truth! Before you climb
　the stairway to godhood!」

stage0093a_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Silence, false god!
　I deny anyone who uses power
　to cast others aside, as you do!」

stage0093a_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$甲児$$
「If that's what you call a god,
　then we'll become the power
　to strike that god down!!」

stage0093a_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Foolish, you humans!
　Gods are eternal! Gods are undying!!
　Immortality is the power of a god!!」

stage0093a_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Someday, I shall rise again!
　With the power of the underworld!!」

stage0093a_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$宗介$$
「You don't know when to give up!」

stage0093a_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$號$$
「$$ハーデス$$ and the gods of Olympus
　have been destroyed...」

stage0093a_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$凱$$
「B-but... he said something ominous
　right at the end!」

stage0093a_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$弁慶$$
「That's just a dying man's bluff.
　No need to pay it any mind」

stage0093a_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$渓$$
「That's right.
　But before that, there's something
　we have to do」

stage0093a_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Even the wingless have their uses, it seems.
　To defeat that King of the Underworld
　and the gods of Olympus」

stage0093a_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We won't lose!
　With this power we'll beat you, save
　$$ミコノ$$, and protect the world!」

stage0093a_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't get too carried away.
　You still don't know a god's
　true power」

stage0093a_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Words like that won't stop us!
　We're taking $$ミコノ$$ back!!」

stage0093a_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Even the wingless have their uses, it seems.
　To defeat that King of the Underworld
　and the gods of Olympus」

stage0093a_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We won't lose!
　With this power we'll beat you, save
　$$ミコノ$$, and protect the world!」

stage0093a_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't get too carried away.
　You still don't know a god's
　true power」

stage0093a_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$オズマ$$
「At this rate, we'll be pushed back eventually!」

stage0093a_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$クラン$$
「If only we could stop that fake Mugen Attack...!」

stage0093a_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How sad, winged boy.
　...Love and hatred are such similar feelings...
　Taste even a fraction of my despair」

stage0093a_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$n
「Both are just strong feelings for someone else...」

stage0093a_04:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「To take the feeling of love and twist it,
　just slightly, into hatred...!」

stage0093a_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What do I do to save $$ミコノ$$ and the others
　inside the black Aquarion...!?」

stage0093a_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$アルト$$
「I've got wings of my own for that!」

stage0093a_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Let me hear it, $$アルト$$!
　Your soul!!」

stage0093a_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I don't know what you intend,
　but I won't give you even a shred of hope」

stage0093a_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$アルト$$!
　The Mugen Attack is coming!!」

stage0093a_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Too soft, $$ミカゲ$$!
　Don't underestimate an $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ ace!」

stage0093a_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Tch!
　But no matter what you do...」

stage0093a_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ルカ$$
「The Fold Wave System...!
　They're using it to send senior $$アルト$$'s voice!」

stage0093a_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$クラン$$
「But that just amplifies the Fold Wave.
　$$アルト$$ doesn't have power like $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s songs...」

stage0093a_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$バサラ$$
「What's that got to do with anything!」

stage0093a_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$バサラ$$
「A song is feeling!
　It ain't nothin' special!
　If you got a burning heart, anybody can sing!!」

stage0093a_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$不動$$
（Yes...
　That is exactly the path to evolution...）

stage0093a_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$! $$ランカ$$!
　Can you hear my voice!!」

stage0093a_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's pointless.
　Even if they could hear, girls sunk in despair's depths
　can do nothing!」

stage0093a_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't decide that on your own!」

stage0093a_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$アルト$$
「What do you know!
　$$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ would never give up singing!」

stage0093a_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$葵$$
「I'll tell you something else while I'm at it.
　Sure, it might be a love triangle,
　but $$アルト$$'s not the type to toy with feelings」

stage0093a_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$タケル$$
「So no matter how it ends for the three of them,
　it won't turn into the hatred you're hoping for!」

stage0093a_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You wingless...!
　I've let you talk long enough...!」

stage0093a_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$アルト$$
「Just like I fly, they sing!
　Song is $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s wings!!」

stage0093a_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$アルト$$
「Sing! $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$!
　No one can bend your feelings!!」

stage0093a_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ランカ$$
「But if our feelings get turned into hatred...」

stage0093a_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Is your feeling really so weak
　that someone else could twist it?」

stage0093a_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$シェリル$$
「That's more like my rival」

stage0093a_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$シェリル$$
「No one can stop our feelings!
　Not even a god!!」

stage0093a_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Hear our song... hear our feelings!!」

stage0093a_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The triangle of hatred is wavering!?」

stage0093a_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ランカ$$
（I won't lose...!
　Not our feelings!）

stage0093a_04:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$シェリル$$
（Even if our feelings aren't returned,
　I won't hate him...!）

stage0093a_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That's the height of manly honor」

stage0093a_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$宗介$$
「To have two women feel this strongly for you.
　I envy you, $$アルト$$」

stage0093a_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Why...!
　Not even my power can twist their feelings!!」

stage0093a_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「You wouldn't understand!
　This flawless, powerful love!」

stage0093a_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Not even $$アンディ$$ can punch a hole in it!」

stage0093a_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$!
　When did you end up on the Quarter!?」

stage0093a_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I... met Supreme Commander $$不動$$
　while searching for $$ミコノ$$ and $$ゼシカ$$.」

stage0093a_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$アンディ$$
「M-$$ＭＩＸ$$!
　Did you turn back into a girl!?」

stage0093a_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Maybe it's because I heard $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s song.」

stage0093a_04:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$クレア$$
「The life force in their song must have
　awakened what was sleeping inside $$ＭＩＸ$$.」

stage0093a_04:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I can be honest with myself now!
　Let's combine, $$アンディ$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　$$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$ and $$ＭＩＸ$$!!」

stage0093a_04:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$アンディ$$
「The purity of soul I've always protected!
　My honed chastity explodes, right now!!」

stage0093a_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Aah!
　I never knew being a girl could feel
　this wonderful, until now!!」

stage0093a_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Somehow... I'm starting to feel good...」

stage0093a_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$グラハム$$
「This, this is truly love!」

stage0093a_04:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$五飛$$
「Hmph... A feeling that rivals even the gods?」

stage0093a_04:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Now he can't use that punch anymore!」

stage0093a_04:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「This is our chance!
　Let's push the attack!!」

stage0093a_04:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There's another triangle of hatred!
　With this power, the likes of you...!」

stage0093a_04:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$アンディ$$
「This is as far as your big talk gets you!」

stage0093a_04:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I will never forgive you for twisting love!」

stage0093a_04:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$!
　I won't let your feelings go to waste!!」

stage0093a_04:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$アルト$$
「Like I'd let it get away!!」

stage0093a_04:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Why is that thing the Galaxy fleet used!?」

stage0093a_04:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What I summoned along with the
　trans-dimensional life form will prove useful here」

stage0093a_04:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$アルト$$
「You think something like that can stop me now!!」

stage0093a_04:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That wing...!
　Is it holding the sun within!」

stage0093a_04:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$不動$$
「$$早乙女アルト$$.
　Aim for its chest」

stage0093a_04:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$不動$$
「Rescue them.
　I'll take it from here」

stage0093a_04:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$!
　You gave power to my wings!」

stage0093a_04:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But at that position, those two...!」

stage0093a_04:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$クレア$$
「Now is the time I show my Element ability!」

stage0093a_04:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So this is the Chairwoman's power...!」

stage0093a_04:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$クレア$$
「...I got carried away, for someone my age...」

stage0093a_04:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$クレア$$
（$$不動$$ is fighting too.
　So I...）

stage0093a_04:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$!
　Take $$ランカ$$ and run!」

stage0093a_04:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$キャシー$$
「We've secured $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Good! Now half of his power source
　is completely lost!」

stage0093a_04:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You crafty wingless ones!
　But I have another triangle of hatred!」

stage0093a_04:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$!
　Don't think things will always go your way!」

stage0093a_04:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You puny wingless ones...!
　I no longer need your bodies!」

stage0093a_04:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You wing dog!
　Trying to protect your own other half!」

stage0093a_04:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But it's useless!
　You cannot stop my power of hatred!」

stage0093a_04:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$不動$$
「$$スパーダ$$, $$ユノハ・スルール$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ジン$$!
　It really is you, $$ジン$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$ジン$$
「That day, $$不動ＺＥＮ$$ saved me.
　And I've been hiding ever since,
　to slip past $$ミカゲ$$'s notice.」

stage0093a_04:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$ジン$$
「But that's over now!
　I'll grasp my future with my own hands!」

stage0093a_04:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$ユノハ$$!
　I'll fight alongside you two!」

stage0093a_04:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$ジン$$...
　So you found your own fight too.」

stage0093a_04:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Hmph... So he too defied fate,
　and overcame it.」

stage0093a_04:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$ジン$$, $$カグラ$$! And the girl with pale green hair!
　I have no more use for you!」

stage0093a_04:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The true Wings of the sun...
　Originally worn alone by an ancient god」

stage0093a_04:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Once I manage to awaken it,
　the cursed bride and I are the only Elements needed!」

stage0093a_04:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now, I ring the wedding bell of vengeance!」

stage0093a_04:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$カイエン$$
「The cursed bride!
　Was my Despair Foresight foreseeing this all along!?」

stage0093a_04:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I'll steal this hateful woman's body,
　and become the god of genesis birthing a new world!」

stage0093a_04:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Bastard!
　You still have this much power left!」

stage0093a_04:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I fight alone!
　I'm not playing pretend-friends with you!」

stage0093a_04:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$カグラ$$, there's no need to play pretend.」

stage0093a_04:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$ジン$$
「You've always clashed with $$アマタ$$ for real.
　This time, just get on Aquarion together with him.」

stage0093a_04:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「...Sounds like it could be fun.」

stage0093a_04:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$クレア$$
「Teleporting both of them into Aquarion!」

stage0093a_04:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Please, $$アマタ$$!
　Let me help protect it too!」

stage0093a_04:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Idiot $$アマタ$$!
　This isn't the place for sorry, is it?」

stage0093a_04:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn, what a clueless bastard!
　Making a woman this down-and-out cry!」

stage0093a_04:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I love it so much I can't stand it!」

stage0093a_04:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$n
「I can feel it...!
　Their passionate feelings!」

stage0093a_04:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$クレア$$
「This is exactly what $$不動$$ wanted,
　to create a myth together...!」

stage0093a_04:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Now all that's left is to bring $$ミコノ$$ back!」

stage0093a_04:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You wing dog!
　Hurt again and again, yet you still rise...
　Do you want that woman so badly!?」

stage0093a_04:r_ddda297a7997c73b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then, Apollonius!
　I'll burn away everyone you love!!」

stage0093a_04:r_02c89111c680d125.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We'll protect everyone we love!!
　And I'll protect $$ミコノ$$!!」

stage0093a_04:r_b267a0ec877acc0e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$! I'm coming, now!!」

stage0093a_04:r_62e68b17a29fb53b.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I loved Apollonius this much, was betrayed,
　hurt, and filled with hatred...」

stage0093a_04:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「That's right...!
　This much...! This much...!」

stage0093a_04:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$, what are you...」

stage0093a_04:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I... I kept looking away...!
　From the sin of taking the man I love from you,
　and from your sorrow...!」

stage0093a_04:r_3b207a6e3b8e5700.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Do whatever you want with me!
　But please, save everyone in this world!」

stage0093a_04:r_017c609cb5528ca1.text:
$$アマタ$$
「No way!
　I could never abandon $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That day, I watched my mother go!
　And I've regretted it ever since!」

stage0093a_04:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So this time, I won't watch you go!
　I won't say goodbye!」

stage0093a_04:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Together with the person I love!
　Together with $$ミコノ$$!
　I want to protect this world!」

stage0093a_04:r_2e5685a3629d0a5e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll always be by your side!
　Even if $$ミコノ$$ grows old and wrinkled!
　Even if time stops here and you become myth!」

stage0093a_04:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll be right there beside you!」

stage0093a_04:r_1054a335fa977a7a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Flying on forever, loving you forever!」

stage0093a_04:r_b302a6e2e0ca76ec.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I was born to love $$シルフィ$$.
　Across 12,000 years...
　But he loved now... loved $$ミコノ$$ as she is now!」

stage0093a_04:r_e4166e8a5b45cb96.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Get lost!
　All of you, get lost to the far side of love!!」

stage0093a_04:r_5430d9d76e38cf47.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Genesis Union! GO!
　$$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$!!」

stage0093a_04:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text:
$$カグラ$$
「No, it's not EVOL!
　Its new name is-!」

stage0093a_04:r_bdf41f6a0fb7b286.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's alright.
　The Wings of the sun have returned to where they belong.」

stage0093a_04:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Looks like that $$ミカゲ$$ bastard vanished too.」

stage0093a_04:r_d4488f1ef5175d87.text:
$$ジン$$
「Who knows.
　Knowing him, he's probably alive somewhere,
　stubbornly clinging to life.」

stage0093a_04:r_4f98756e8506f766.text:
$$シュレード$$
「That realist streak of yours...
　You haven't changed a bit.」

stage0093a_04:r_722be3d36da4979c.text:
$$ランカ$$
「$$アルト$$, big brother... everyone...」

stage0093a_04:r_b8aead2ff492ad33.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Oho...!
　To think you'd take down the $$堕天翅$$. You're of some use after all.」

stage0093a_04:r_e18660f45e2bdaae.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ハーデス$$!
　You're all that's left!」

stage0093a_04:r_c01f3d97d765f442.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't think my power is the same as the $$堕天翅$$'s!
　I'll teach you the true essence of a god's power!」

stage0093a_04:r_f2a506c32c68b595.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$, go back to the Quarter!」

stage0093a_04:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Got it, $$アマタ$$!
　...But I'm fighting too...!
　To protect the world together with you!」

stage0093a_04:r_db902169b0ec12e0.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Got it, $$ミコノ$$!
　Let's do this together!」

stage0093a_04:r_bccb0c4cb58aa146.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... accept the punishment of the gods.」

stage0093a_04:r_888c0b4c627ecec4.text:
$$カトル$$
「It's no good!
　We can't dodge that attack!」

stage0093a_04:r_0ee1b4c987332e23.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Is taking the hit our only option!?」

stage0093a_04:r_96d6ee6ffbd6d1e6.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「If only we could cut off the source of his power...!」

stage0093a_04:r_86a99be7bc977b4a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's pointless, wingless one.
　As long as love cannot be erased, neither can hatred.」

stage0093a_04:r_83e0e74db0ae4d4f.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Alright!
　Just keep tearing each other apart like that!」

stage0093a_04:r_d85829b2f9bff450.text:
$$ダリー$$
「If we use this chance, we can fight...!」

stage0093a_04:r_d45ebbbfa8153f69.text:
$$キタン$$
「Don't be so damn stingy about it!
　Crushing every last enemy is our way!」

stage0093a_04:r_518305c95e4d1da4.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「If we're careless, we'll get caught in a pincer from both sides!
　Don't let your guard down!」

stage0093a_04:r_7c9a719cd8f27d1d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「We're the best combo there is!」

stage0093a_04:r_808269c7e458f2a5.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Nothing scares me!
　Not with $$アンディ$$ by my side!」

stage0093a_04:r_980e935235423ee4.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Maybe I've got a talent for beast taming...」

stage0093a_04:r_dc9b1e7f62a8afc8.text:
$$カグラ$$
「All that gloominess from before feels like a lie now!」

stage0093a_04:r_a93aa11c23414e87.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah...
　This really does suit me better!」

stage0093a_04:r_d243a6836b127987.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The wingless... much less a child,
　could never understand my love or hatred.」

stage0093a_04:r_cbab585f941e5667.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't care, don't scare,
　cock-a-doodle-doo, so there!」

stage0093a_04:r_06e36bd71f54f272.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No way I'm losing
　to some guy trying to wreck the world out of spite!」

stage0093a_04:r_a9e024bdcd6975b2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here I come, jilted Wing!
　Don't go taking it out on someone else just 'cause I beat you!」

stage0093a_04:r_978bd43401f7be8a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The sun belongs to my beloved Apollonius alone...!
　It doesn't suit your puppet!」

stage0093a_04:r_e9bd6b1804d36e0a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is our hope!
　And hope lights the future of the world!」

stage0093a_04:r_7aac40a4f34dcec3.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is our sun!
　No matter what you say, I'll fight alongside $$鉄人$$!!」

stage0093a_04:r_371b88cba6c82378.text:
$$タケル$$
「A feeling that would destroy the world can't be love!」

stage0093a_04:r_4cb558f092561fde.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wingless one, denying my love...!?」

stage0093a_04:r_119dbefe27cdac46.text:
$$タケル$$
「Someone like you, who steals another's happiness,
　has no right to speak the word 'love'!」

stage0093a_04:r_e174d36b825c4290.text:
$$タケル$$
「If you love someone,
　you love the whole world they live in!」

stage0093a_04:r_56176fc60ad96ecd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A twin split between light and darkness, acting like you understand!
　You should fall into darkness too!」

stage0093a_04:r_577385dbd6d74922.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「One who transcends causality.
　I am not one to be pitied by the likes of you!」

stage0093a_04:r_ee134f0fa96047a6.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll put you to sleep.
　if love is what torments you.」

stage0093a_04:r_204e41a08c5ec720.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Are you... the same as me...」

stage0093a_04:r_497aca854c5f874d.text:
$$桂$$
「I get what it's like to love someone!
　But just because you got dumped,
　holding a grudge and taking it out on everyone is just too lame!」

stage0093a_04:r_f2e19618032127d3.text:
$$桂$$
「Keep talking and you'll only look worse!
　Just quietly exit this world, jilted Wing!」

stage0093a_04:r_9d5428667d48c806.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This man's sorrow... it's deep and dark!」

stage0093a_04:r_21454fd877c0ae7b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A mere wingless one, touching my heart!?」

stage0093a_04:r_c8c3a682c9917367.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You, who feel love and hatred,
　are no different from us at all!」

stage0093a_04:r_f612b6b60810e300.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't make me laugh!
　The wingless, the same as the Wings!?」

stage0093a_04:r_09068a6fd74f79b7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why we'll stop you!
　Before your hatred leads the world to ruin!!」

stage0093a_04:r_4ff0d278b79d1168.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What a pitiful man you are.」

stage0093a_04:r_05b808b1583f5be2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If you keep on living like this,
　you'll one day taste our loneliness, same as the Wings.」

stage0093a_04:r_72be9250b889c959.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Isn't it supposed to be 12,000 years...?!」

stage0093a_04:r_402b4aaf0ee30986.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's the cursed memory carved into the Wings...!
　Know this, wingless one: destroying you now,
　before you get there, is my mercy!」

stage0093a_04:r_2cfc9851abe4070e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I can't follow this man's self-serving logic...!」

stage0093a_04:r_0831afdf480052ed.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Your love and hatred are none of my concern.」

stage0093a_04:r_1c9bf7ffbf9314a5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No wonder a wingless one can't grasp my feelings.」

stage0093a_04:r_b402ecf2db57f319.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「All I need
　is the fact that you're an enemy of the world.」

stage0093a_04:r_adc5793509f8d46c.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This man's heart... burns hotter than anything...!」

stage0093a_04:r_f581e32ff0b84e01.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Whatever you are,
　if you're an enemy, I'll eliminate you swiftly.」

stage0093a_04:r_c5ffa17ba0fae8d3.text:
$$シン$$
「Even the humans you're trying to destroy
　each have someone they love!
　And yet...!」

stage0093a_04:r_b251d2d3a7cdba85.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How dreadful.
　I don't even want to think a wingless one
　could feel something like we do.」

stage0093a_04:r_abc1d4645695a0e0.text:
$$シン$$
「If you're going to drag the world
　into your hatred like that...!」

stage0093a_04:r_ae527ac0a641a269.text:
$$シン$$
「I'll show you!
　That humans too will stake their lives
　fighting for what matters to them!」

stage0093a_04:r_eb56670c83981cc6.text:
$$キラ$$
「You fight with a feeling called hatred
　and a power called Aquarion...」

stage0093a_04:r_90b6cb0493a2982b.text:
$$キラ$$
「But where you're aiming it is wrong...!」

stage0093a_04:r_a5181af1cc2bdd02.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wingless one, lecturing me on reason...!」

stage0093a_04:r_357749a704e3cf55.text:
$$キラ$$
「If you won't understand what we're telling you,
　then I'll fight you...!」

stage0093a_04:r_9da55d8320b82bc6.text:
$$キラ$$
「With the feelings and the strength inside me!」

stage0093a_04:r_7accc1b1cfd86010.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So you've touched my sorrow.
　Then you must have trembled at its depth and darkness, no?」

stage0093a_04:r_301d85713d2cddd7.text:
$$刹那$$
「But that's no reason to destroy the world!」

stage0093a_04:r_59a1074cc884fdbd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It seems you've come a little further
　than the other wingless ones.」

stage0093a_04:r_b66bbe1f07a7674e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And that power will make you lonely.
　When it does, will you still be able to deny me?」

stage0093a_04:r_b77f3e5c390fe067.text:
$$刹那$$
「...I don't know what lies ahead.
　But I can't let you go,
　not while you're trying to destroy the world!」

stage0093a_04:r_fa7a261c85f92c5a.text:
$$刹那$$
「To protect this world's future, I'll fight you!!」

stage0093a_04:r_16141de28d738543.text:
$$バナージ$$
「One who nips the future... nips possibility itself...!
　You're an enemy of the world!」

stage0093a_04:r_39d8b5a2657c65a4.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wingless one has no future either way.
　You'd be happier destroyed by me here.」

stage0093a_04:r_1a123affe838b8b1.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm not putting up with logic like that!」

stage0093a_04:r_fb72b64c842ba487.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You may indeed be a dangerous existence...
　Perhaps I can't just leave you be.」

stage0093a_04:r_f9ff2a77c392a048.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't let you have your way!
　Not with me, not with this world!!」

stage0093a_04:r_3167d694c10c96fb.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You who carry the blood of beasts.
　Have you ever thought about why
　you exist in this world?」

stage0093a_04:r_54e755252ec3acc4.text:
$$葵$$
「I've got no interest in your philosophical games.」

stage0093a_04:r_5dcadcd6c77bc7dc.text:
$$葵$$
「Or your annoying sob story about love, either!」

stage0093a_04:r_f22e056851da9461.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Seems you want to die, wingless one.」

stage0093a_04:r_84e951432a30244f.text:
$$葵$$
「Team D's not weak enough
　to lose to a guy wrecking the world over getting dumped!」

stage0093a_04:r_97923e3dd5dae64b.text:
$$葵$$
「If you love destruction that much,
　go blow yourself up somewhere out of sight!」

stage0093a_04:r_c8b34405ed7bfde7.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Hear my song, and that gloomy mood blows right away!」

stage0093a_04:r_93b46e3c24ed4825.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Here I go, Wings!
　Liiisten to my soooong!!」

stage0093a_04:r_d7cd6f0e351ca403.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Ah... the power of life...
　My hatred is being healed...）

stage0093a_04:r_4b3e91da51d87c72.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（But I mustn't forgive...!
　Apollonius... the world Apollonius loved...!）

stage0093a_04:r_912c58272c320559.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A sinful man, toying with the love of two maidens...」

stage0093a_04:r_378632856490e9d0.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A sinner like you has no right to judge me.」

stage0093a_04:r_49dde825db6b02a0.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So you were aware of it after all...
　Then come, fall into the darkness with me...」

stage0093a_04:r_b99c671eb373edd1.text:
$$アルト$$
「I've no interest in hearing the words
　of someone who gives in to heartbreak and hates others!」

stage0093a_04:r_0f9b6f684aa8f438.text:
$$アルト$$
「What I have to do right now
　is protect $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$, and protect the world!」

stage0093a_04:r_23d7f155539c7c51.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Putting off the problem like that, are you?」

stage0093a_04:r_c8e48adccc9bbba8.text:
$$アルト$$
「My mind's made up...!
　And that's none of your business!!」

stage0093a_04:r_cd3b88564d0672c9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「God, Wings, whatever you are, I don't care,
　if you're my enemy, I'll smash you!」

stage0093a_04:r_ed6e99341ad5bf40.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You eternal warrior chosen by the Getter rays...!
　So you're here too!」

stage0093a_04:r_a671f14759794503.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Seems like you know something
　about the Getter rays too.」

stage0093a_04:r_7ff5aecfd0f37b20.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do you want to know the answer, wingless one?」

stage0093a_04:r_ed9690679f1aa20f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I've got no interest in that.」

stage0093a_04:r_121b55dcb47984aa.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You mean to refuse evolution of your own will!?」

stage0093a_04:r_0c472072ac8bda60.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If I wanna move forward, I'll do it on my own feet!」

stage0093a_04:r_aeef429ff90ba18f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You who inherit the power of the god of light!
　As if a wingless one could wield that power!」

stage0093a_04:r_f0ce8e3e0d75533e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up, you dumped bastard!
　I promised $$ゼウス$$
　I'd carve out the future with our own strength!」

stage0093a_04:r_87e728176c45393f.text:
$$甲児$$
「The darkness in you, trying to destroy the world,
　I'll break it with the light of Mazinger and me!」

stage0093a_04:r_5aa4e72c511af6eb.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You don't know your place...!
　Fall into the darkness of my heart and despair in the black!」

stage0093a_04:r_8e2f92d078970a2b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A powerless wingless one, coming at me?」

stage0093a_04:r_e8ecfd162319c1e6.text:
$$赤木$$
「Sure, I'm just an ordinary salaryman,
　but I've got something splendid that you don't!」

stage0093a_04:r_0bb68446ec330a05.text:
$$赤木$$
「Guts and spirit!
　That's why, even if I got dumped like you did,
　I wouldn't take it out on everyone!」

stage0093a_04:r_8e1ebf6b0c149f4b.text:
$$赤木$$
「Destroying the world out of spite and blame,
　just understand already
　how pathetic that is!!」

stage0093a_04:r_86f0e9b721a4f655.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Black Megadeus, I remember you too.」

stage0093a_04:r_84158af5a79e4d35.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A memory from 12,000 years ago, is it.」

stage0093a_04:r_c42f7ca81fe0cf88.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No...
　Further back than that... a memory from 120,000,000 years ago.」

stage0093a_04:r_836fc0eae35929e9.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「From the looks of it, the memory's still sealed away.」

stage0093a_04:r_aed2fc42c9a9ecdd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But you'll come to know it eventually.
　What the system your god left behind means.」

stage0093a_04:r_ebc3eec9f9e218b1.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm sick of men who spout nonsense...!
　Such fellows had better vanish from my sight!」

stage0093a_04:r_271fbb35b579a866.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You who inherit the god's legacy...
　why don't you use that power to guide the wingless?」

stage0093a_04:r_b40fe3d3e6f2b1d9.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Eternity is something humanity doesn't need.」

stage0093a_04:r_778c6eb2f5afc622.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How foolish, to give up the path to godhood yourself...」

stage0093a_04:r_3fb74a41e682c7de.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Not enough to drag the world into misplaced spite.」

stage0093a_04:r_fbdb8764f80a1b12.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「What this world needs isn't a frozen eternity,
　but a future overflowing with possibility!」

stage0093a_04:r_d1b8cb87f8ea00d6.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「My comrades and I will drive off the dark that seals it!」

stage0093a_04:r_bba76accfb31e66d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wingless one who knows nothing of love...」

stage0093a_04:r_6095c82e60cdd7af.text:
$$宗介$$
「But compared to you, drowning in love
　and spouting worthless nonsense, I live better.」

stage0093a_04:r_ad702e22165a11de.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Pitiful...
　Love is supreme... above this entire world.」

stage0093a_04:r_df79b5dc7ceda4c0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then I will defeat you,
　and take my time finding out for myself!」

stage0093a_04:r_48a06834bb510d7d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wing dog, daring to defy me!?」

stage0093a_04:r_f19a063712278769.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm no wing dog Polon, and no Apollo!
　I'm $$アマタ・ソラ$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_48fd2b5d0978ba1c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm not bound by the past like you!
　I fight for the present, and for the future!」

stage0093a_04:r_90591ae4aa6d92d6.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You have no future!
　I will destroy everything Apollonius loved!」

stage0093a_04:r_3c39aed29379134c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「As if I'd bow to your hatred!
　We have a love that won't lose to it!」

stage0093a_04:r_bff5468c57365d6b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「My friends, my comrades, my family, the world...
　and $$ミコノ$$, I love them all!
　As long as I have this love, I won't lose to you!!」

stage0093a_04:r_9520c4f160aa3ebd.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$!
　I'm taking $$ミコノ$$ and this world's future
　back from you!!」

stage0093a_04:r_173107393504e4d1.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I will never forgive you for using us!」

stage0093a_04:r_e839f83a2e7828b1.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I merely lent a hand to the desires already inside you.
　Please stop pushing the blame onto me.」

stage0093a_04:r_48e8a7d08b0e09ba.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'll admit that!
　But we've changed!」

stage0093a_04:r_7d5585f6d8b1df8d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「We're not the type to sit around whining
　about the past forever, like you do!」

stage0093a_04:r_5933be40e8f9d954.text:
$$カグラ$$
「For the world we're going to live in... for the future,
　you're disappearing, $$ミカゲ$$!!」

stage0093a_04:r_0d848a222f69347d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'll fight!
　To protect the world's future!」

stage0093a_04:r_bd5c0088c2d22ef6.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How admirable...
　even though the world you came from
　was destroyed by an embodiment of endless destruction.」

stage0093a_04:r_77fc21c69be0890c.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I don't believe that!
　The fight Big Sis and everyone and I fought
　protected the future!」

stage0093a_04:r_7b9baf664ed0cd70.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's the same in this world!
　To fight against something like you,
　$$ガンバスター$$ and I are here!」

stage0093a_04:r_a0fcf4d8788a2bce.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The wind's path leads to Tengen...
　And what waits beyond it is despair...」

stage0093a_04:r_d8483ee925825d04.text:
$$シモン$$
「That despair, my drill will bore right through it!」

stage0093a_04:r_dae622560a4cfc83.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wingless one who doesn't know his place...
　Do you even know what awaits beyond that despair?」

stage0093a_04:r_aa09da82b4c52a2a.text:
$$シモン$$
「Whatever waits, if it's my enemy, I'll bore through!」

stage0093a_04:r_d0acd2176373fca3.text:
$$シモン$$
「My drill is the power to move forward into the future!
　Someone like you, drowning in despair,
　can't stop me!」

stage0093a_04:r_c2f74d776b632961.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The door to a new world... a vessel for a god's descent...
　But you don't know the meaning of your own existence.」

stage0093a_04:r_2e7c2f5aef3a7531.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... sorry to him, but,
　since you came at me, I'll punish you too.」

stage0093a_04:r_a8286dce43de45a6.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I hate people like that,
　who talk like only they understand and move others around!」

stage0093a_04:r_e1b7430fdaa24f35.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I won't let someone like that
　do whatever they want with the world everyone lives in!」

stage0093a_04:r_ced1bbcf059b07d7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I see...
　It's no wonder you'd think that.」

stage0093a_04:r_dda2f4922920a4e0.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But you're making a huge mistake.」

stage0093a_04:r_20cd18288d206a35.text:
$n
「The way you talk about him like he's not even human...!
　I don't like it!」

stage0093a_04:r_d96c64f9a77d53aa.text:
$n
「I know it well.
　I'm the one who hunts angels...!」

stage0093a_04:r_da78018881956191.text:
$n
「You, destroying the world, are my prey!!」

stage0093a_04:r_4267b07b216d5d90.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「If you claim to have inherited
　$$ゼウス$$'s soul, then show me
　that power!」

stage0093a_04:r_1a9b7326b53f45cc.text:
$$甲児$$
「Damn it!
　Guess that hero name isn't
　just for show after all!」

stage0093a_04:r_02b69055356d9cfb.text:
$$甲児$$
「But!
　If I can't beat you, there's no way
　I can beat $$ハーデス$$ either!」

stage0093a_04:r_c4554163734c62f1.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm getting past you, $$ガラダブラ$$!
　We're fighting $$ハーデス$$ to
　protect this world!!」

stage0093a_04:r_890ab04baf542979.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「You who wield Getter rays!
　No human can control that power!」

stage0093a_04:r_4bea4465e893e4b0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Sorry, Hero Skeleton!
　I don't give a damn
　about Getter rays!」

stage0093a_04:r_7123af524c72acf7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Getter Robo is power to crush
　the enemy! I'm taking your
　'hero' title!!」

stage0093a_04:r_0b8e88db1a9dd44e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You brat!
　I'll give you this much credit,
　challenging the King of the Underworld!」

stage0093a_04:r_a4798a17c691a81a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm not fighting for
　words like that!
　I'm fighting to beat you!」

stage0093a_04:r_31f18ff9dc8f076e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You make me laugh!
　I've no time for a child's nonsense!」

stage0093a_04:r_b4515f604561df78.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You jerk!
　If you lose to this kid,
　quit calling yourself a god!」

stage0093a_04:r_3cf33f3773748d0f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I really hate guys who sit
　there acting all high and mighty!!」

stage0093a_04:r_533e554662b8c631.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So you're Mars, the one
　who defeated Emperor $$ズール$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_b06b2a23a76e8ce4.text:
$$タケル$$
「Why do you know about $$ズール$$!?」

stage0093a_04:r_cbff35a90e8ad7cd.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Dark power gathers into one...!
　He and I share the same source!」

stage0093a_04:r_26db4dd6c24f9835.text:
$$タケル$$
「Flames of darkness...!
　This power... it's dangerous!」

stage0093a_04:r_d224d5baf3493ab2.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Mars!
　Die before you learn why
　you and your brother were born!」

stage0093a_04:r_3ee3743094a4a145.text:
$$タケル$$
「The meaning of why my brother
　and I were born...!?」

stage0093a_04:r_180eb1536d754e3c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Die, Mars!
　Fall into the world of darkness
　along with your brother!」

stage0093a_04:r_015674a403ccf13a.text:
$$タケル$$
「Not a chance, $$ハーデス$$!
　I promised my brother I'd fight
　for the universe's peace and future!」

stage0093a_04:r_ef91c7636fe8aad4.text:
$$タケル$$
「I'll unleash all of
　my psychic power!
　$$ハーデス$$! Go back to the world of darkness!!」

stage0093a_04:r_397bc0c659cbf227.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I see!
　This puppet that houses the sun
　truly opposes the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!!」

stage0093a_04:r_f2effcece0132e9d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Are you talking about the
　Solar Energy Conversion Device!」

stage0093a_04:r_f7c5d0246e396cd5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That power is a nuisance
　even to me! I'll finish off
　whoever bears the sun's light myself!」

stage0093a_04:r_7aa9edfa8692bb8d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Not a chance!
　$$鉄人$$ is the power of justice
　my father left me, to protect peace!」

stage0093a_04:r_994d9e1d2a462e94.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　Drive away $$ハーデス$$'s darkness
　with your solar power!!」

stage0093a_04:r_a6b5f5b4b8ab58f8.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I see...!
　So you too were gathered
　into this world!」

stage0093a_04:r_f30ba6c950a686bc.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「But even your existence,
　which transcends causality, is
　powerless before a god! I'll show you!」

stage0093a_04:r_6bfb2bfe97891db7.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Then let me teach you
　something too」

stage0093a_04:r_96474b2c3a6e7165.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I bow to no one's rule.
　Not even a god's」

stage0093a_04:r_5bf2ab7960121e96.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Found you, true singularity!
　I'll make good use of your power!」

stage0093a_04:r_023f1f7532dd508f.text:
$$桂$$
「That's a passionate approach,
　but no thanks when it's some
　tough-looking old geezer」

stage0093a_04:r_037dafa5c5124420.text:
$$桂$$
「Though with an attitude as
　condescending as yours, I'd refuse
　even if you were a beautiful woman!」

stage0093a_04:r_b126c5fbf2356174.text:
$$桂$$
「This $$桂木桂$$ is a man who
　loves beautiful women and freedom!
　Brutes like you piss me off most!!」

stage0093a_04:r_87d57a77ad22ca35.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This one too bears the sun's
　budding light within!」

stage0093a_04:r_88aa7aea54616b53.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This guy... what's he
　talking about!?」

stage0093a_04:r_e44c30f3b562be6c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I'll tell you one thing!
　Being struck down here is a mercy!
　Survive, and you'll surely regret it!」

stage0093a_04:r_4711ef8ef992a14e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What meaning is there in
　a life someone else decides!」

stage0093a_04:r_ca13a7fc435dcc9d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「King of the Underworld, $$ハーデス$$!
　Don't think you can bend
　humanity to your will!!」

stage0093a_04:r_58564bddc1ac08b5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So this man is the forerunner!」

stage0093a_04:r_6a06cc16f6683240.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Evolution is not permitted
　to humanity! That is the
　judgment of the gods!」

stage0093a_04:r_e2efb08e47011ced.text:
$$アムロ$$
「As if I'd let something like you
　decide what humanity should be!」

stage0093a_04:r_d1f368432258ec05.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We believe in humanity's future!
　If something stands in the way
　of that path, I will fight it!」

stage0093a_04:r_6330bf8e56b514cf.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Humanity has no future!
　That is the will of the gods!」

stage0093a_04:r_3efe6b08505e6b39.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Too afraid to even speak!
　Then die!!」

stage0093a_04:r_889b93ef12326ef0.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You have no right to
　decide our future」

stage0093a_04:r_fd9bcf7d78c6eeac.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Enemy of humanity, Mycenae.
　I will eliminate you...!」

stage0093a_04:r_83d6f0d49d974865.text:
$$シン$$
「Do you understand that each
　human you treat like vermin
　has a life of their own!」

stage0093a_04:r_36ba6439169b2472.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Such a thing means nothing
　before the will of the gods!」

stage0093a_04:r_d19e2d3230e09c6a.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Understand this, humans!
　In this universe, your existence
　is no different from a single bug!」

stage0093a_04:r_807f7b4a12c3c6ab.text:
$$シン$$
「Each of those humans has a life,
　has joys and sorrows,
　and is living for all they're worth!」

stage0093a_04:r_857468de19815523.text:
$$シン$$
「Someone who calls that
　meaningless is no god!!」

stage0093a_04:r_72f66f82d72a5e2c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The law of the universe is
　survival of the fittest!
　Humanity's fate is to be culled!」

stage0093a_04:r_ac913a939029996b.text:
$$キラ$$
「By gaining power, it seems
　you forgot something important...」

stage0093a_04:r_31efa01531be032d.text:
$$キラ$$
「I won't accept people like you
　who've forgotten love and kindness...!」

stage0093a_04:r_8455446770647f64.text:
$$キラ$$
「Power alone can't make
　a person happy! I'll fight you
　for not understanding that!!」

stage0093a_04:r_4dd1fae15f4d641e.text:
$$刹那$$
「One who rejects others,
　forcing their desires through
　with power...!」

stage0093a_04:r_4f6b361fd2c92e92.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That is the law of the universe!
　Battle is the universe's truth!
　Only ruin awaits those who defy it!」

stage0093a_04:r_9c146547df9ac929.text:
$$刹那$$
「I won't accept
　anything like that!」

stage0093a_04:r_d9f2b8012ba37fc5.text:
$$刹那$$
「A world where fighting
　never ends must not exist!!」

stage0093a_04:r_cdf86c7be0122aaf.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Fear the gods, humanity!
　And regret your own powerlessness!」

stage0093a_04:r_62cbe4ab456fe01c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You people... aren't
　gods at all...!」

stage0093a_04:r_de0d7af4922e4e7a.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Such delusions!
　Has fear broken your mind!」

stage0093a_04:r_bc321459e2182228.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Only humans possess a god...
　A god called possibility...」

stage0093a_04:r_f60d86deb9f0ed30.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Possibility is an infinite future!
　One who'd steal that is no god!」

stage0093a_04:r_92a92fbd8a2b734e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The blood of beasts
　ends here! Die, little girl!」

stage0093a_04:r_9183713553991f3e.text:
$$葵$$
「Sorry, but our blazing blood
　won't be cooled by threats like that!」

stage0093a_04:r_05ebe641ed2da125.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This fighting spirit...!
　Just as I thought, these ones are...!」

stage0093a_04:r_9164bd75a5c29894.text:
$$葵$$
「Too late to say stop now!
　Our fighting spirit's already
　in the red zone!」

stage0093a_04:r_a65f2c6073076762.text:
$$葵$$
「Here we go, $$ハーデス$$!!
　Let's do this!!」

stage0093a_04:r_4bc0637364d8a149.text:
$$バサラ$$
「I don't know if you're a god
　or what, but liiisten to my song!!」

stage0093a_04:r_bdfba076c58e1ff5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This one...!
　Don't tell me, the legendary
　《$$アニマスピリチア$$》!」

stage0093a_04:r_b9f77e5acc0942b6.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't go spouting 《$$ゲペルニッチ$$》
　nonsense! More than that,
　layer your soul onto my sound!!」

stage0093a_04:r_bd55bb9029e467d1.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Nguh...!
　Even a man like this, gathered here...
　just what is happening on this planet!」

stage0093a_04:r_e93d2827733385fa.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Nguh...!
　Why are you here!?」

stage0093a_04:r_891efb3059812af8.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Wrong guy, old geezer!
　Or are you still half-asleep!」

stage0093a_04:r_299ce4b54f92ed39.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So you still haven't awakened to your true purpose!
　Then victory is still within my grasp!」

stage0093a_04:r_3baa2769c86302e6.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That's awfully gracious of you!
　Pretty humble for a self-proclaimed god!」

stage0093a_04:r_18c345e4b68c12c7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「But it's too late now!
　We're already fired up!」

stage0093a_04:r_91b7a61294c05a90.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You picked a fight with humanity and me!
　Don't think you'll get off easy!!」

stage0093a_04:r_265114998c9cdda8.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Child of Getter rays!
　What do you intend to do on this planet!?」

stage0093a_04:r_d99f05052bd03651.text:
$$號$$
「I'm just watching over where humanity is headed.
　It's each and every person who decides that path.」

stage0093a_04:r_ec02d70600f29cb1.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Spare me the pretty words!
　I'll erase you before you show your true nature!」

stage0093a_04:r_9071778073533579.text:
$$號$$
「I'll tell you this, gods of Olympus...!
　Whoever crushes humanity's potential is my enemy!」

stage0093a_04:r_1e07f9d18fe0f887.text:
$$號$$
「Let's do this, Getter!!
　We're protecting Earth's future!!」

stage0093a_04:r_5f7d81050a6eb0d2.text:
$$赤木$$
「It's a fight between an office worker and a god!
　Let's go all out!!」

stage0093a_04:r_c5d14cea3feb3258.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「How pitiful!
　Mustering the last of your courage to face me!」

stage0093a_04:r_94c58684d3d2f2cc.text:
$$赤木$$
「What's wrong with that!?
　Every human you call a mere bug
　is living with all their might!」

stage0093a_04:r_cdb2805b3e42414b.text:
$$赤木$$
「To protect that,
　god or devil, whoever I face,
　I'll fight with my life on the line!!」

stage0093a_04:r_90c004166d6998d3.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's the fight $$ダイ・ガード$$ and I are waging!!」

stage0093a_04:r_b559a709c05c466e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's no way to ask someone something.
　Gods, it seems, know nothing of manners.」

stage0093a_04:r_f3d13455fde20d76.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「A god showing courtesy to mere humans? Unthinkable!」

stage0093a_04:r_d940e68fde96e892.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「As long as you cling to that arrogance,
　we're unlikely to become friends.」

stage0093a_04:r_d4539352ead4c516.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't make me laugh!
　Don't think mere humans are our equals!」

stage0093a_04:r_3a86021bb5195379.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even after seeing the bond between $$ゼウス$$ and $$甲児$$,
　you still say that. You disappoint me, $$ハーデス$$.」

stage0093a_04:r_028e78edf8b38c6c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just as I thought, you don't deserve godhood...!
　At the least, you're nothing like
　the god carved into this $$ビッグオー$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_5589409279f087d9.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So that's it, I see...!
　What you're riding is...」

stage0093a_04:r_cd169febb82df2fb.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The time for talk is already over...!
　From here, we'll play by your rules!」

stage0093a_04:r_69ec96fb8da7c25c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now you'll learn!
　The power of $$ビッグオー$$, built in the name of a god!!」

stage0093a_04:r_9a22aa8d49b88417.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「You're mistaken about what a god's power means.」

stage0093a_04:r_112c133deaee5282.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Mere humans, speaking as if they understand!」

stage0093a_04:r_8075f8bcc76f7df8.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even if I myself am heir to a god's existence?」

stage0093a_04:r_ce4876c69922ab65.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「What!?
　A god's secret art was left behind in this world!?」

stage0093a_04:r_e1a3d4cb622d1379.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Humanity has no need for such a thing!
　I deny the gods!」

stage0093a_04:r_f9c80ffd03c02dbb.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「We seek the future!
　I won't kneel to gods who lost their future
　in the name of eternity!!」

stage0093a_04:r_947f475c9b344398.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Come then, human!
　I'll teach you just how powerless you are!」

stage0093a_04:r_b4b6f78fa1c50d56.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Struck speechless with fear!
　Not that I blame you!」

stage0093a_04:r_6cf284b1a823ba2b.text:
$$宗介$$
「You may indeed be a god...」

stage0093a_04:r_6603b33ecc4f006c.text:
$$宗介$$
「But as a soldier, you're second-rate.」

stage0093a_04:r_2809477b354952d7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Anyone who puts on airs on a battlefield dies early!
　Learn that the hard way.」

stage0093a_04:r_70e2d7c09c997d80.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Speaking that way to this undying god...」

stage0093a_04:r_69d2b6ca8a9af483.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The Wings...!?
　No, this is a wing dog!」

stage0093a_04:r_d3c638baa229ea65.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「In the end, a wing dog is a wing dog!
　Those frail wings won't get you far against a god!」

stage0093a_04:r_37ddf9facc0bf611.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm... not the wing dog Polon!
　I'm human, $$アマタ・ソラ$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_731c9dd791416eab.text:
$$アマタ$$
「And these wings of mine...!
　are wings that soar past enemies, sorrow, and fate!」

stage0093a_04:r_6d64b6e7f8b0364d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld!
　My wings will soar past your darkness too!!」

stage0093a_04:r_19afcbf950a9cea2.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This one...!
　A survivor of the civilization of fire!」

stage0093a_04:r_b3edb5df8a517f28.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't underestimate me!
　Even alone, $$ガンバスター$$
　still holds a flame inside it!」

stage0093a_04:r_b6bf9ce8b93b16bb.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「My own flame...!
　And the flame entrusted to me by Big Sis!
　That's what burns as $$ガンバスター$$'s fire!」

stage0093a_04:r_ed2ebfef41991018.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Very well, human!
　Show me the power you honed fighting $$バアル$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_554fe32c27a8ac23.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「An evil god shrouding Earth's future in darkness...!
　I will never give up!」

stage0093a_04:r_96103ead94103454.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「With this $$ガンバスター$$,
　I will definitely smash your wicked ambitions!!」

stage0093a_04:r_c97a1484d476bf43.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Man of the Spiral!
　Know that the wind's destination is ruin!」

stage0093a_04:r_8d1375c34ba16830.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't think saying 'ruin' or 'annihilation'
　will shut us up!!」

stage0093a_04:r_d51e9ed1fd8496c5.text:
$$シモン$$
「If something's holding me down, I drill through it!
　If there's a wall in front of me, I drill through it!
　That's my drill!」

stage0093a_04:r_fb979af042fbee1e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「No wonder the Anti-Spirals are on the move!
　This one's Spiral already surges toward the heavens!」

stage0093a_04:r_3b3d21c9f004f81b.text:
$$シモン$$
「It's too late for regrets, $$ハーデス$$!
　You made an enemy of me, don't expect it easy!!」

stage0093a_04:r_2f8e597bcc3abc88.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You human...!
　Using this one as a vessel to walk the path to godhood!」

stage0093a_04:r_5d05b9eadc4a190e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「What on earth are they talking about...!?」

stage0093a_04:r_7ae9b8fbbedf5dee.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I'll crush you before the time comes!
　A human becoming a god is not something I'll allow!」

stage0093a_04:r_2bb1d8407f3ac7af.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I-I don't really get what they're saying, but...!」

stage0093a_04:r_c7924874296909f6.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm a member of $c too!
　Even against a god, I'll fight alongside everyone!!」

stage0093a_04:r_61dc876016accae5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The bearer of a fragment of Taiji...!?
　No, that's not it!」

stage0093a_04:r_df305a2342916c62.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「But I can certainly feel it...
　A trace of their power...!」

stage0093a_04:r_039dc11024d8b02e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Just what is this one...!?」

stage0093a_04:r_4feb6512048866ab.text:
$n
「I'll say the same right back at you, $$ハーデス$$!
　What exactly are you!?」

stage0093a_04:r_11ed17ac30eaf4e9.text:
$n
「The god I know isn't some ugly pig
　drowning in naked greed like you.」

stage0093a_04:r_8cf17d680a14f12c.text:
$n
「Falling for such a cheap taunt shows
　just how low a god's level really is!」

stage0093a_04:r_c0cfc49d1cf3253b.text:
$n
「Good timing!
　Before I settle things with the Angel,
　I'll crush this self-proclaimed god!!」

stage0093a_04:r_ec3afb65f0579128.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Stop this fight, $$ハーデス$$!
　Our mission is to watch over those who follow us!」

stage0093a_04:r_ce2710e169c8638f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Wrong, $$ゼウス$$!
　A god is a being that rules over all,
　and one permitted to do so!」

stage0093a_04:r_ec365b30f337a99c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「And indeed, that's how they behave!
　In the name of a god's messenger!」

stage0093a_04:r_f0f31573186c8442.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Are you saying you'll go along with that too!」

stage0093a_04:r_57f1229a4b0ea6c6.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Go along with it?
　Don't talk nonsense, $$ゼウス$$!
　Our true purpose is to win the war of the gods!」

stage0093a_04:r_4b90ce5d89aa8205.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「And for that, this planet, brimming with $$オリジン・ロー$$,
　is indispensable to our strength!」

stage0093a_04:r_db2f030e03a681e6.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「If that means you'll take human lives for it...!」

stage0093a_04:r_3c52ed9cc95a59a1.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Then as a god, I will strike you down!
　Together with the strong-hearted heroes of steel!!」

stage0093a_04:r_746d3d898e1d4c60.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「R-ridiculous!
　You're facing $$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld!」

stage0093a_04:r_4f61c9b3b557c131.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I-incredible!
　Is this the shape of evolution humanity has reached!?」

stage0093a_04:r_28f133955535cb56.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Then I'll face you with all my power!
　A god losing to a human...
　no, to an animal, must never happen!」

stage0093a_04:r_ee98c860ad1449b5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「S-stop it!
　Don't look at me with those moist round eyes!」

stage0093a_04:r_e7a1f41d97e70d5e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ah...!
　The anger inside me, the hatred...!
　24,000 years of darkness, melting away...!」

stage0093a_04:r_1dbe0977faf01cd1.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then, beloved beast!
　Let me pour my love into you!」

stage0093a_04:r_fa2bd82e1bedf0ab.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You irritating little bug!
　I'll tear those wings right off!」

stage0093a_04:r_3ae0555ed58eaebe.text:
$$アルト$$
「Try it if you can!
　I won't let someone like you steal my hope!」

stage0093a_04:r_2ed995d97899edf2.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This one...!
　To feel no fear at all before me,
　$$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld!」

stage0093a_04:r_f0796af355a7d45b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Hell or the underworld, I'll still fly!
　For the sake of what I have to protect!!」

stage0093a_04:r_898b60275d679036.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Successor to $$ゼウス$$!
　I'll repay the debt from the age of myths!」

stage0093a_04:r_188606e662816bcf.text:
$$甲児$$
「Still clinging to the past, how small of you,
　$$ハーデス$$!」

stage0093a_04:r_03c88626faaa0ed3.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You...!
　Do you mean to mock the gods!?」

stage0093a_04:r_6a02825cc269991d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up!
　You trample on life, how could you be gods!」

stage0093a_04:r_876f8e0c409bcbad.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'll show you!
　The power of humans you call mere bugs...!
　The power of one who believes in hope!」

stage0093a_04:r_124d91e7c4f89ed0.text:
$$甲児$$
「And the power of Mazinger, filled with light!!」

stage0093a_04:r_e9e087ff23d7e995.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「T-this one...!
　Transcending humanity, becoming a demon god!?」

stage0093a_04:r_a754ae5b31bcd6db.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ハーデス$$! Return to the darkness of the underworld!!」
